title: Per-Task Fidelity Scorer and Calibration Checks for FP8/INT8 Rollouts
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Implement a modular per-task scoring suite and automated calibration checks that will be used as a gating mechanism for FP8/INT8 model rollouts. The goal is to detect task-specific regressions early (classification, generation, summarization, QA, MMLU-style reasoning) and to provide deterministic pass/fail signals for CI and canary deploys. This ticket focuses on metric implementations, calibration-quality checks, integration with the eval harness, and dashboarding hooks for Console alerts.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Implement scorer modules for: perplexity (LM outputs), MMLU-style multi-choice accuracy, Rouge/L, Rouge-1/2, BLEU (translation tasks), and a plugin API for task-specific scorers.

A2: Provide a calibration-check stage that computes: histogram KL, per-layer scale drift, A/B comparison of percentile clipping effects, and a compact calibration report (JSON) for each candidate quant profile.

A3: Define numeric gating rules: perplexity change <= 2% (relative) for base LMs; top-1 accuracy regression <= 1.5% absolute for MMLU buckets; Rouge-L F1 drop <= 1.0 point for summarization; BLEU drop <= 1.0 point for translation. Gate tripped if any rule violated across critical task suites.
A4: CI integration: one-click presubmit step that runs reduced-size task suites and uploads a calibration report artifact; full-suite canary runs in staging with dashboard links.
A5: Dashboard: add per-profile rows showing pass/fail, metric deltas, and a link to raw eval artifacts; alerting on repeated failures (3 consecutive canary failures).
tasks: Design scorer SDK API (scorer factory, input/output contract, metric normalization)
Implement core scorers: perplexity module, MMLU prompt/answer checker, rouge/bleu wrappers aligned to our tokenizer outputs
Build calibration-check pipeline: ingest calibration histograms, compute KL/JS, compute percentile clipping statistics, output calibration report
Hook scorer suite into existing eval harness (adapter for reduced CI runs and full staging runs)
Create gating evaluator service that reads calibration reports and applies numeric gating rules
Add Console dashboard cards and alert plumbing for per-profile gating results
Write unit/integration tests and lightweight synthetic datasets for CI
Document runbook: how to interpret reports, how to override gates with risk notes (requires SOC/PM sign-off)

notes: Design trade-offs: reference-based metrics (ROUGE/BLEU) are sensitive to tokenization and oracle choice; they are best used in combination with reference-less signals (perplexity drift, KL, layer-scale drift).

Calibration workflow: run canonical calibration dataset -> compute histogram per-activation/per-tensor -> generate candidate quant profile -> run reduced eval suite -> if pass, schedule full staging run -> if staging pass, promote to canary. Gate failure requires a documented investigation and a second independent rerun.

Runtime considerations: scoring must be efficient — we will compute streaming metrics for generation tasks to avoid storing full outputs where possible, and we will sample B=256 examples for CI presubmits to keep runtime under 20 minutes.

Future work: add regression clustering to automatically find representative failing prompts and feed those into a calibration retraining loop; extend scorer SDK to support per-customer validation suites.
